Name: Rico_Brief_01
Speaker: Rico
Text: Neon Row is leaking. Two crews on the east mouths, cameras still live. Marcus wants a debrief after — he always does. Who do you put on the street?
ChoiceB_Text: Rico and Ray. Hold the corners.

Name: Rico_Brief_Pick
Speaker: Rico
Text: Your table. Keep it to three. Marcus stays in the Hall — he is the debrief, not the street.

Name: Rico_Brief_Ray
Speaker: Rico
Text: Ray already knows the corners. I'll walk with him. You can still swap bodies on the roster.

Name: Rico_Brief_Lena
Speaker: Lena
Text: The alley cameras dump to a clerk on Market. If we cut the lights we lose claim but we lose heat. If we leave them, Marcus will smell it.
ChoiceA_Text: Lena walks. Cut the lights if it comes to it.
ChoiceB_Text: Keep Lena off the street. I'll pick.

Name: Marcus_Win_01
Speaker: Marcus
Text: You held the Row. The corners are ours until morning. I don't want the story you tell the Hall. I want names. Who called the shots on the ground?
ChoiceC_Text: I called it from the Hall.

Name: Marcus_Win_Rico
Speaker: Marcus
Text: Rico can carry a street. Cameras still have us. Burn the footage, pay the clerk, or leave them and hope.

Name: Marcus_Win_Crew
Speaker: Marcus
Text: Shared credit keeps them. Cameras still have us. Burn, pay, or leave them.

Name: Marcus_Win_Ego
Speaker: Marcus
Text: They noticed. Loyalty thins when the Hall takes the name. Cameras still have us.

Name: Marcus_Win_End
Speaker: Marcus
Text: That's the debrief. Watch the meters. The warehouse door is open if Neon isn't on fire.

Name: Marcus_Loss_01
Speaker: Marcus
Text: We lost the Row. Heat is going to crawl toward the Hall. I still need names. Who do we put on the next walk, and what do we do about the cameras?
ChoiceA_Text: Rico owns the miss. He'll fix it.

Name: Marcus_Loss_Rico
Speaker: Marcus
Text: Rico will remember that. Cameras still have the miss. Burn, pay, or leave them.

Name: Marcus_Loss_Crew
Speaker: Marcus
Text: Shared blame is cheaper than a scapegoat. Cameras still have the miss.

Name: Marcus_Loss_Ego
Speaker: Marcus
Text: Owning it from the Hall is rare. They'll give you one more night. Cameras still have the miss.

Name: Marcus_Loss_End
Speaker: Marcus
Text: That's the debrief. The Row is thin. Let the night run and watch control leak — or go take it back.

Name: Rico_Docks_01
Speaker: Rico
Text: Warehouse door on the river is ajar. Two bodies minimum. Vex knows that door. Neon has to stay under a burn or we can't leave the Row.
ChoiceB_Text: Vex and Rico. It's her door.
ChoiceC_Text: Ask Lena about the warehouse cameras.

Name: Rico_Docks_Pick
Speaker: Rico
Text: Two on the river, three if you can spare them. Marcus stays in the Hall.

Name: Rico_Docks_Vex
Speaker: Vex
Text: I grew up on that crane line. You put me on the door I won't sell it tonight.

Name: Rico_Docks_Lena
Speaker: Lena
Text: Warehouse cameras dump to a clerk on the river, not Market. Cut the lights and the takeover heat dies. Leave them and the river stays loud.
ChoiceA_Text: Lena walks. Cut the lights if it comes to it.
ChoiceB_Text: Keep Lena off the river. I'll pick.

Name: Marcus_Docks_Win_01
Speaker: Marcus
Text: You took the warehouse. Takeover is noisy even when it holds. I want names. Who opened the door?
ChoiceC_Text: I called it from the Hall.

Name: Marcus_Docks_Win_Vex
Speaker: Marcus
Text: Her door, her name. Warehouse cameras still have us. Burn, pay the dock clerk, or leave the river cameras.

Name: Marcus_Docks_Win_Crew
Speaker: Marcus
Text: Shared credit keeps them. Warehouse cameras still have the walk.

Name: Marcus_Docks_Win_Ego
Speaker: Marcus
Text: They noticed. Loyalty thins when the Hall takes a river. Cameras still have us.

Name: Marcus_Docks_Win_End
Speaker: Marcus
Text: That's the river. Docks will leak if you never put bodies on it. Tick, or walk Neon if it's slipping.

Name: Marcus_Docks_Loss_01
Speaker: Marcus
Text: The warehouse stayed shut. Heat on the river. I still need names.

Name: Marcus_Docks_Loss_Vex
Speaker: Marcus
Text: She's already thin. Warehouse cameras still have the miss.

Name: Marcus_Docks_Loss_Crew
Speaker: Marcus
Text: Shared blame is cheaper than a scapegoat. River cameras still have the miss.

Name: Marcus_Docks_Loss_Ego
Speaker: Marcus
Text: Owning a river miss from the Hall is rare. They'll give you one more night.

Name: Marcus_Docks_Loss_End
Speaker: Marcus
Text: That's the debrief. The warehouse stayed shut. Tick or send them back.

Name: Rico_Market_01
Speaker: Rico
Text: Stalls on the Strip will pay if we reclaim them. Not v0. Don't open this until the Row loop is boring.

Name: Rico_Ward_01
Speaker: Rico
Text: Old Ward is masonry and empty lots. Reclamation work. Not v0.

Name: Event_Vex_Press_01
Speaker: Vex
Text: I'm not at the table. I'm at the door. Buy me or I start looking at buyers.
ChoiceA_Text: Sit. Your name on the river.

Name: Marcus_Vex_Held
Speaker: Marcus
Text: The river door is seated. Put her name on the next walk or this was rent.

Name: Marcus_Vex_Lean
Speaker: Marcus
Text: She's closer to a buyer. Next tick can bring one. Call her before the night does.

Name: Event_Vex_01
Speaker: Vex
Text: I have a buyer for the river. Last number. Buy me, cut me, or I walk it tonight.

Name: Event_Vex_Cut
Speaker: Vex
Text: I sold it because you kept me thin. Keep the warehouse. I'm gone.

Name: Event_Vex_Sale
Speaker: Vex
Text: Clerk already has the route. You can burn cameras. You can't unsell it.

Name: Marcus_Vex_Gone
Speaker: Marcus
Text: The river door is empty. Names still at the table need a line.

Name: Marcus_Vex_End
Speaker: Marcus
Text: That's the door. Tick, walk Neon, or take the river without her.

Name: Rico_Table_01
Speaker: Rico
Text: You put your name on the hold. The corners heard it from the Hall, not from me. Buy them back or they're yours.

Name: Marcus_Rico_Word
Speaker: Marcus
Text: He heard it twice. He's thin. Press the corners before a night does.

Name: Event_Rico_Press_01
Speaker: Rico
Text: You keep putting your name on the hold. Mine's getting thin. Buy the corners or I walk.

Name: Marcus_Rico_Held
Speaker: Marcus
Text: The corners are seated. Don't ego him twice in a row.

Name: Marcus_Rico_Lean
Speaker: Marcus
Text: He's closer to walking. Call the corners before a tick does.

Name: Event_Rico_01
Speaker: Rico
Text: Hall keys. A buyer. Last number. Buy me, cut me, or I leave the note.

Name: Event_Rico_Cut
Speaker: Rico
Text: You wanted the name on the door. Keep it. I'm off the board.

Name: Event_Rico_Sale
Speaker: Rico
Text: Keys are already gone. The corners will leak without me.

Name: Marcus_Rico_Gone
Speaker: Marcus
Text: The corners are empty. Ray can hold a mouth. He can't hold two.

Name: Marcus_Rico_End
Speaker: Marcus
Text: That's the corners. The Hall still stands. Watch the leak.

Name: Marcus_Morning_01
Speaker: Marcus
Text: Morning. The take is on the books. Bank it, pay who stayed, or burn leftover footage.

Name: Marcus_Morning_End
Speaker: Marcus
Text: That's the books. Walk Neon, take the river, or let the night run again.
